message:
perf: shrink the images, make the motion setting real

The logo was shipped three times at 854 KB each (logo.png, favicon.png,
apple-touch-icon.png) and the author avatar at 362 KB. On the home page the
logo alone was three quarters of the page weight.

- logo.png is now a 512x512 square crop at 277 KB, used for the Open Graph
  image; the navbar loads a 6 KB 128px version instead
- favicon.png is 2 KB, apple-touch-icon.png is 11 KB
- avatar.jpg is 13 KB instead of 362 KB
- deleted public/bee-logo.png, public/icons.svg and the three leftover Vite
  template files in src/assets — none of them were referenced anywhere

The "Reduce motion" setting did nothing at all: the toggle was wired to the
raw state setter, so the choice was forgotten on the next reload, and even
while it was on nothing read it. It now persists, sets data-motion on <html>
and switches framer-motion to reducedMotion="always"; the operating system
setting is honoured as well.

The same applied to "Show week badges" — it was never saved either.
author: BSS Index Developer
